title: Data Management Module
summary: This module centralizes all data handling operations, providing robust mechanisms for data validation, transformation, and persistence across various storage solutions.

nodes.label: Validate Data Integrity
nodes.title: Data Validation
nodes.description: Ensures incoming and outgoing data conforms to predefined schemas and business rules, preventing corruption and maintaining consistency.

nodes.label: Transform Data Formats
nodes.title: Data Transformation
nodes.description: Converts data between different structures and formats, preparing it for processing, storage, or external consumption.

nodes.label: Store and Retrieve Data
nodes.title: Data Persistence
nodes.description: Manages the storage and retrieval of data from various persistent layers, including databases and file systems.

nodes.label: Handle File I/O
nodes.title: Input/Output Handling
nodes.description: Provides utilities for reading from and writing to different file types, such as JSON and CSV, facilitating data exchange.

nodes.label: Core Logic Modules
nodes.title: Core Logic Modules
nodes.description: Represents the main application logic that interacts with data management services for processing and storage.

groups.label: Data Processing Pipeline
groups.title: Data Processing Pipeline
groups.description: The sequential flow for ensuring data quality and preparing it for various uses within the system.

groups.label: Data Storage & Access
groups.title: Data Storage and Access
groups.description: Components responsible for the reliable storage, retrieval, and external exchange of data.

groups.label: External Interaction
groups.title: External Interaction
groups.description: Represents the primary consumers and producers of data managed by this module.
